name: @figentra/docs
description: Figentra documentation — Mintlify, docs-as-code. Content in src/ (Mintlify root dir); navigation generated from the tree.

scripts.dev: pnpm nav && cd src && mint dev --port 3333
scripts.build: pnpm nav && node scripts/mdx-check.mjs && cd src && mint validate && mint broken-links
scripts.test: node scripts/nav.mjs --check && node scripts/mdx-check.mjs && node scripts/fix-links.mjs --check
scripts.links: pnpm nav && cd src && mint broken-links
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck
